name: label
description: Categorical 'label' types accepted by 'plot item create structure label <type>' (3DEC 9.0).
notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0.
verification: Verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('?' enumeration), 2026-08-14. Per-DOF link-* variants enumerate individually (15 forms); listed compactly here.

keywords.name: link-attach
keywords.description: Link attach condition (also per-DOF: link-attach-x/-y/-z, link-attach-rotation-x/-y/-z). Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47.

keywords.name: link-target
keywords.description: Link target entity type. Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47.

keywords.name: link-yield
keywords.description: Link yield state (also per-DOF: link-yield-x/-y/-z, link-yield-rotation-x/-y/-z). Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47.

keywords.name: coupling-yield
keywords.description: Coupling spring yield state (liner/geogrid/shell flavor only). Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47.

keywords.name: plastic-state
keywords.description: Plastic state (liner flavor; beam enumerates plastic-int/plastic-yield instead). Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47.

keywords.name: side
keywords.description: Liner side selector (liner flavor only). Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47.
